changes: Nearby now shows a live count of visible, living hostile players. It updates on sightings, departures and once a second, including in combat and beyond the row limit; remembered sightings do not inflate it.
The enabled counter stays visible at zero. Target, focus and mouseover sightings stay fresh while visible, and the combat queue counts every pending enemy.
Enable the counter: Highground `/hg nearby on`; standalone Nearby `/hgn on`; standalone Bounties `/hgb nearby on`.
notice: Restart WoW after updating; this release adds an addon file, so /reload is not enough. CurseForge files may still be in moderation.
